cleavage_agent: samples containing 10 mg of protein per tissue were digested with trypsin
enrichment_method: prior to phosphopeptide enrichment via immobilized metal affinity chromatography
fractionation_method: the resulting peptides fractionated via strong cation exchange chromatography
instrument: Phosphopeptides were analyzed in duplicate via LC-MS/MS on an LTQ-Orbitrap mass spectrometer.

ptm: To better understand the role of phosphorylation in maintenance of physiological differences among tissues, we performed proteomic and phosphoproteomic characterizations of nine mouse tissues.
